review_text: App crashes every time I try to open the task list. Happened after the 3.0.1 update. Samsung Galaxy S21 Android 13. Completely unusable now.
Can't login since the latest update. I enter my password correctly but get a 'Session Expired' error immediately. iPhone 14 iOS 17.2.
Amazing app! The new calendar sync feature works perfectly. Productivity has gone through the roof. Love the clean UI.
Please add a dark mode option. Using the app at night is very uncomfortable. Would really improve the experience.
Data sync is completely broken. I lost 2 weeks of notes after syncing across devices. Pixel 7 Android 14. This is a serious data loss issue.
Would love to see a widget for the home screen to quickly add tasks without opening the full app. Great app overall!
The notification reminders stopped working after update 3.0.1. I'm missing deadlines because of this. OnePlus 11 Android 13.
Works perfectly! Best productivity app I've used in years. The collaboration features are top notch.
